refnamediv.refpurpose: Checks if a service entry exists in the SCM database

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolwin32_exists_service stringservicename stringmachine""
Checks whether a service exists in the SCM database.
Administrative privileges are required, as the Service Control Manager is opened with full access and the service with the DELETE access right. Without them, a Win32ServiceException is thrown (access denied) instead of returning &false;.

&reftitle.parameters;
servicename
The short name of the service.
machine
The optional machine name. If omitted, the local machine will be used.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &true; if the service exists, &false; if it does not exist.
